participation.context: Stopped in the lane with the tables in his hand, and clasped them blank when the lid shut.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You listened through the open shutter. You did not mark the leaf. You did not stay.

title: Heard a pavan through the open shutter

participation.context: Spoke the three sentences, very low.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Spoken of. Not in the close.
participation.name: the lady of the parish

story.body: You put the lane into three sentences, and you stopped.

title: Said the three sentences in the close
